title: GUN CARD AND KEYS CHIP TIDY
why: His note of 2026-10-25 (played on 33.17, still true on 34.83): in raid, the right hand lower corner menu and the minimized controls f1 key are awkward. The gun card was at least 246 wide whatever it held, so its left half was empty, a short lime accent bar sat on its top edge and the backpack row hung at the bottom; it now hugs its rows with one padding on every side, keeps every piece of information, and the accent bar is gone (it was decoration, not a meter). The folded f1 controls chip floated loose on the map in a different spot in each mode; it now docks at the left end of the tactical belt on the belt caption row, in the caption style, left of key 1, in career, the demo and the second window, and F1 opens the list upward from it (his rs-1 answer kept: mid bottom left, folded).
now: The gun card in the lower right is snug around the gun name, the rounds and the backpack row, with no lime stub. The f1 controls chip sits just left of belt key 1, on the same row as the fire use caption, and F1 opens the list right above it. Watch for: the card never jumping in width while you shoot or reload, and the opened list never covering the feed or the belt.
